opening.speaker: map_seller
opening.line: The map seller sees Thad, and lights up like a lamp.

options.text: Is that a map to Mott's strike?

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: It's FORTY-ONE maps to Mott's strike, sir!

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: They're all right about the strike, sir! They only disagree about where.

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: I draw them, sir! From the accounts.

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: Every man who's ever told me where it is. Hundreds, sir, and not one of them disproved!

options.text: How much for one that's actually right?

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: That's the deluxe, sir. Four dollars.

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: Same map, sir. I look you in the eye while I sell it.

options.text: Is Ezra Pike on any of your maps?

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: Pike? Pike's on every one, sir! Little cross, top of the hill.

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: That's his… the undertaker explains it better, sir. Down the lane.

options.say: He's on the map, sir! I mark everybody. That hill's my most popular corner.

options.text: Do you have one with pianos on? I'm a tuner.

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: He draws a small piano on a map, beside a cross.

exchange.speaker: map_seller
exchange.line: There's your piano. Twelve feet down.

options.text: Have you ever dug where one says?
options.say: Dig my own map, sir? That'd be like a man eating his own dinner!

options.text: I've taken enough of your time. I'll be taking more later.
